note: Private RV park in the Bear Creek valley on the northwest edge of Grande Prairie, reached only from 116 St at 162 Ave / Twp Rd 722 (follow the blue park signs). Gated, with a trout pond, walking trails along Bear Creek, a rec room, U-pick berries, an on-site winery and a seasonal corn maze. Sells nights, weeks and months. --Claude
summary: Operator rates page (2026) confirms C$55 base, all sites full service 15/30/50 A, +C$5 extra adult, tax extra; online booking via Park With Us (up to 6 days); Good Sam 10% on daily rates; facilities and booking added; riverview kept; long-stay tests pass; pin is the operator's GPS at the gate, ~300 m from the loops.

WATERFRONT (stored riverview, checked hard): KEEP riverview. Esri imagery (0.44 m/px): the southeast corner of the large southern loop sits ~18-25 m from a bend of Bear Creek, and the south spur's sites ~25-35 m from it; the bank is brush and trees all along, with no open ground to the water, so not riverfront. The stored vocabulary is 'riverview' for what is a creek; the operator says 'Scenic walking trails and Bird watching along Bear Creek'.
